draft.hypothesis: The repeated target-test failures occur after many reactive patch attempts, suggesting the agent is spending excessive steps thrashing on edits rather than converging. Cap total reaction steps at 10 to force earlier commitment to a promising patch and reduce unproductive late-stage churn.
draft.expected_effect: Fewer TARGET_TEST_FAILED repetitions because the agent will be less likely to bury successful fixes under additional speculative patch attempts, and will allocate more limited steps toward high-value verification actions.
draft.possible_risk: Some tasks may require more than 10 steps for legitimate multi-step diagnosis and repair, so the cap could cause premature termination on complex targets and reduce overall pass rate.
